styleLock.backgroundSystem: two alternating fields only: a deep bottle-green seamless stage #1B4536 for the opening, module and closing screens, and a bright field of pale marble #F1EFEA or seamless white #FFFFFF for the packshot, structure, spec and comparison screens; the green stage carries at most two out-of-focus monstera leaves at opposite corners and one rounded card plate in the same green; never a black or charcoal stage
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool 5500K soft diffused key from the upper left with a white fill card, broad soft shadows, one honest contact shadow under the case, one thin specular line along polished metal edges only, no hotspots, no coloured gels; the single lifestyle screen switches to daylight from an open door on the left
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale white marble block #F1EFEA as the main riser, seamless white #FFFFFF for the compliance packshot, warm micro-cement floor #E6E1D8 for the lifestyle screen, grey micro-cement specimen plinth #6F7073 with a chamfered corner for the closing screen
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin, one family only; one headline plus one pill badge plus two or three short labels per screen, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」, one thin champagne rule as the only divider, no dense body copy, all figures left as blank plaques
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline circle badges in champagne #D6BC84 with one simple line glyph each, laid out in a 3x2 grid, one deliberately empty plaque reserved under every badge; a hairline-outlined white rounded card with a champagne border is the only content frame
styleLock.presentationRules: the subject always reads as a rectangular blow-moulded carry case with a rear-hinged lid, two front latches, an integrated top handle and a moulded cavity tray; every tool stays seated in its own cavity and never loose; hero slight 3/4 angle repeated across the opening, lifestyle and closing screens; stable product scale and centred placement
noDrift: no black or charcoal stage screens
no loose tools outside their moulded cavity
no legible brand wordmark, model code, printed digits or tape-measure numbers
no rendered figures instead of blank plaques
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium hardware-tool-kit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep bottle-green stage #1B4536, pale marble #F1EFEA and seamless white #FFFFFF as the base fields with one champagne hairline accent #D6BC85; neutral-cool 5500K soft diffused key light from the upper left with a white fill card, broad soft shadows, one honest contact shadow under the case and one thin specular line along polished metal edges only; bright fields and the bottle-green stage alternate screen by screen, the green stage carrying at most two out-of-focus monstera leaves at opposite corners, never a black or charcoal stage; pale marble block #F1EFEA as the main riser, warm micro-cement floor #E6E1D8 for the single lifestyle screen and a grey micro-cement specimen plinth #6F7073 for the closing screen; modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin, one family only, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」, one headline plus one pill badge plus two or three short labels per screen; thin single-weight hairline circle badges in champagne #D6BC84 in a 3x2 grid, each above one deliberately empty plaque, and a champagne hairline-framed white rounded card as the only content frame; the product is always a rectangular blow-moulded carry case with a rear-hinged lid, two front latches, an integrated top handle and a moulded cavity tray, every tool seated in its own cavity; stable product scale, centred placement and the same slight 3/4 hero angle across the opening, lifestyle and closing screens; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible brand wordmark or printed digits, no invented figures where a blank plaque is reserved.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实（9 张详情页长图切片，本任务归档目录 _sources/工具箱/panels/panel-01~09）：01 墨绿无缝背景＋白色大理石方台，绿色吹塑工具箱开箱立于台上，左右上角各一片龟背竹绿叶，右上两行大字标题与一枚描边胶囊角标，右侧两行英文小字与三枚圆点；02 大理石底上压一块墨绿圆角大卡，卡内 3x2 细线描边圆形图标位，每图标下一行中文小标与一行英文副标，卡外底部另起大字屏；03 墨绿满幅底＋四枚金线描边白色圆角空卡位（应用示意占位），卡下各一行金色标签，末尾转白色小节头；04 近白大理石底的产品信息屏：左上深绿色块标题、两栏规格标签清单（左栏七项、右栏七项，均无数值）、右下角长宽高三条细引线与端点；05 墨绿底小节头（白底胶囊角标＋金色大字＋短横杆）＋一枚金线描边大白卡，卡下编号 01
